scope: Manually mapped synchronous Boolean policy decisions; no claim of complete natural-language or temporal consistency.

GAP.quote: Keep the original task's dependent work stopped until a suitable catalog entry is retrieved, or the acquisition workflow's verification and explicit retention choice have completed.

CONDITIONAL.quote: Conditional continuation with unverified assumptions also requires an explicit user choice and conditional labeling.

TOOLING.quote: Otherwise resolve setup or report the blocker.

RETENTION.quote: Catalog promotion is the default recommendation; task-local retention requires the user's explicit choice and must stay visibly separate from catalog entries.

SCOPE.quote: Implementation is authorized only within the user's requested scope and resolved contract.

LEDGER.quote: For an authorized lifecycle task, record these in the shared obligation ledger; a standalone requirements task may retain them in its specification without creating a lifecycle ledger.

PROOF.quote: mark it unsupported for automated proof admission.

FRESH.quote: Admit only when every declared required check has fresh successful evidence, requirements have honest validation receipts and blocking decisions are resolved.

H-requirements-formalization.quote: Use specification-consistency for joint satisfiability, input/output coverage and nonvacuity.

H-spec-driven-development.quote: Route intent to requirements-formalization, conflicts to specification-consistency, representation/API decisions to implementation-mapping, and required mathematical gaps to abstraction-acquisition after reporting them.

H-implementation-mapping.quote: Use [mathematical-tests](../mathematical-tests/SKILL.md) for derived tests and [implementation-conformance](../implementation-conformance/SKILL.md) for comparison against the mapping.

H-implementation-conformance.quote: use the acquisition workflow for catalog edits and proof promotion when a required mathematical gap is found.

H-abstraction-discovery.quote: Use [implementation-mapping](../implementation-mapping/SKILL.md) to formalize the updated API contract.

H-compositional-verification.quote: Keep each as a separate obligation and use formal-model-checking where appropriate.

H-implementation-refinement.quote: Use mathematical-tests for API tests and implementation-conformance to challenge the mapping;

H-formal-model-checking.quote: Use [implementation-mapping](../implementation-mapping/SKILL.md) to formalize the checked atomic actions into concrete code methods.

H-abstraction-acquisition.quote: Resume the original skill and task using a versioned mapping from the acquired operations and proved propositions to its inputs, API or specification.

H-verification-maintenance.quote: Rerun affected checks using the run command, then check admission.

H-assurance-review.quote: Deliver findings with clause/obligation IDs, source locators, reproduction commands and consequence.

LIFECYCLE.quote: Use compositional-verification for component connections, implementation-refinement for actual source correspondence, mathematical-tests for behavior tests and formal-model-checking for concurrent models.

REVIEW.quote: Before delivery, use implementation-conformance in assurance review mode to challenge the contract and result.

LOOKUP-LOG.quote: Every repository skill that queries the catalog must maintain a durable task-local lookup log.
